description: Discrete quantisation: exactly five increasing vertical bands.
prompt: Write a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader implementing mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord). iResolution (vec3) and iTime (float) are provided; do not redeclare them and do not write main(). Requirements: (1) divide the frame into EXACTLY five equal-width vertical bands; (2) each band has a flat grayscale brightness and brightness strictly increases from the leftmost to the rightmost band; (3) boundaries are hard; (4) the output is static and ignores iTime; (5) no NaN output.
